:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/changeMark.xml).
:::

`changeMark` is the attribute that states whether a visual indication, such as a change bar, is displayed next to a changed element. It is written together with [`changeType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-type/) and [`reasonForUpdateRefIds`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/reason-for-update-ref-ids/). It is optional.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 701 elements carry this attribute. The following table shows the 12 elements that appear in the most schemas.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acronym` | 28 | Optional |
| `acronymDefinition` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionListItemPara` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `changeInline` | 28 | Optional |
| `circuitBreakerRef` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthority` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthorityGroup` | 28 | Optional |
| `copyright` | 28 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `yesOrNoAttType` (based on `xs:int`). The pattern is `[01]` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `1` | The indication is displayed |
| `0` | The indication is not displayed |

## Related rules

- Editorial changes have no change markup (BREX-S1-00044 of the default BREX; Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1).
- An element that has `changeMark` but no `changeType` is treated as an added element (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.1).

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is in `change.changeMark` of nodes and references |
| Add it in an edit | `marking.changeMark` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/). It cannot be omitted when `marking` is passed |

The tool does not choose the value of `changeMark`. It takes the value the user has decided.
